patches.anchor: This file is the highest-priority project-specific rule source for agents.
patches.insert_after_first_match: > See `.agent/constitution.md` for non-negotiable safety constraints (discipline gates, forbidden actions, database & migration invariants). Amendments require explicit human approval - they do not flow through the rule-evolution workflow.

append_to_array_unique.notes: Synced to agent-bootstrap-template v0.10.0: constitution split (non-negotiable safety constraints moved to .agent/constitution.md), rulebase pointer added, optional pre-tool-use rulebase-guard hook template, token budget for constitution, and updated structured validator that enforces the constitution + pointer pair on 0.10.0+ manifests.
